body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A tiny abandoned underground bathhouse reused as shelter. Empty shallow basin, low divider walls, folded blankets, a cracked water spout and warm communal repair nook. A dry drainage passage leads into the dungeon. COMPOSITION: High oblique cutaway; rectangular empty basin lies diagonally, groups crowd one end and mage another. COLOR SCRIPT: dusty rose stone, desaturated bottle green, ink-gray shadow, faint straw lights. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
